blocks.text: Draft for Jared's approval. Built only from the monthly MLS® figures (SnapStats) for Sapperton. It has no local notes, street boundaries, schools or listing feed yet; see the open items below.

Sapperton, New Westminster: 10 houses and 33 condos and townhomes listed at the end of September, with 1 and 2 sold in the month. It is one of 14 communities the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® figures break out for New Westminster.
Sapperton homes listed and sold, June to September 2026

Sapperton, September 2026. Detached houses: 10 listed at month end and 1 sold in September, a sales ratio of 10% (a buyers’ market). Condos and townhomes: 33 listed at month end and 2 sold in September, a sales ratio of 6% (a buyers’ market).

The monthly write-ups singled out Sapperton for detached houses in September (a sellers’ best bet); condos and townhomes in June (a sellers’ best bet); condos and townhomes in July, August, September (a buyers’ best bet).
Sapperton share of New Westminster listings and sales by month

In Sapperton, its share of the houses listed in New Westminster went from 12.2% in June to 6.1% in September and its share of the condos and townhomes listed went from 5.9% to 7.4%. A share that holds steady while the city moves means the community is following the city; a share that drifts means it is moving differently.

items.t: New Westminster real estate market stats

faq.q: How many homes are for sale in Sapperton?
faq.a: At the end of September 2026 the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® figures showed 10 houses and 33 condos and townhomes listed in Sapperton. Those are month-end counts and they move daily, so ask Jared for a current list.

faq.q: Is Sapperton a buyers’ or sellers’ market?
faq.a: In September 2026, houses had a sales ratio of 10% (a buyers’ market); condos and townhomes had 6% (a buyers’ market). The sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed; on the reports’ scale under 12% favours buyers, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% favours sellers. One month in one community is a small sample, so look at the monthly table above before you decide.

faq.q: How many homes sold in Sapperton from June to September 2026?
faq.a: 6 houses and 14 condos and townhomes sold in Sapperton over those 4 months; detached houses peaked in July with 3 sold and condos and townhomes peaked in June with 6 sold.

faq.q: How big is Sapperton compared with the rest of New Westminster?
faq.a: In September 2026, Sapperton held 6.1% of the 164 detached houses listed in New Westminster and 7.4% of the 444 condos and townhomes listed in New Westminster.

faq.q: What mix of houses and condos is for sale in Sapperton?
faq.a: In September 2026, houses made up 23.3% of the 43 homes listed in Sapperton and condos and townhomes made up 76.7%; of the 3 that sold, houses were 33.3% and condos and townhomes 66.7%.

faq.q: Are there more or fewer homes for sale in Sapperton than in June?
faq.a: Listings of detached houses fell from 19 to 10 (−47.4%) and condos and townhomes rose from 28 to 33 (+17.9%) between June 2026 and September 2026.
